scanNote:
3-UNITNING OXIRGI BETI (23-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Shop till you Drop!' va binafsha-ko'k yorliqda oq '3'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game' sarlavhasi.
27) 'In teams, use the words below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.' 20 ta so'z/ibora qiya harflarda.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation' sarlavhasi.
28) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and repeat.' Oltita nuqtali band: hat - have - hot - hear; Who hit her?; I haven't heard from Henry for ages.; Harriet has got a hundred hats.; He hasn't had a holiday for years.; Harry hates hot dogs.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing' sarlavhasi va qora yozuv '(an article about the shopping facilities in a city)'.
• To'q sariq ramkali quti - maqola yozish qoidasi (qalin harflar bilan ajratilgan iboralar).
29) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and answer the questions.' Oltita savol.

O'NG USTUN:
30) a) 'In pairs, read out the dialogue.' A (Alice) va L (Lisa) o'rtasidagi uzun dialog.
O'ng yuqorida OVAL rasm: ko'k fonda oq TO'R (lace) naqshi - shamol tegirmoni, gullar va qo'ng'iroqlar tasvirlangan; pastida 'BRUSSELS' yozuvi.
   b) 'You have been asked to write an article for a travel magazine about the shopping facilities in Brussels. Use the text in Ex. 6 as a model and the dialogue in Ex. 30a to write your article. (100 - 150 words).'
• Spiralli daftar shaklidagi ramkada REJA: Plan - Introduction (Para 1), Main Body (Para 2, 3), Conclusion (Para 4).
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom' sarlavhasi: 'Read these sentences. What do they mean?' Ramkada ikkita gap: 'In good times people want to advertise, in bad times they have to.' va 'Money makes the world go round.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '23'.

exercises.instructionEn: In teams, use the words below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.
exercises.instructionUz: Guruhlarga bo'linib, quyidagi so'zlar bilan gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko.
exercises.explanationUz:
3-UNITNING BUTUN LUG'ATI.

  ⚠ 20 ta so'z/ibora - hammasi
  18-22-betlarda uchragan.

  ⚠ Ko'pchiligi 19-betdagi Parij va
  21-betdagi Harrods matnlaridan.


⚠ QIYIN IBORALAR:

  plenty of + OT (ko'p)
  such as (kabi)
  security personnel (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  high quality (OT+OT birikmasi)
  autumn collections (OT+OT birikmasi)


⚠ 'FURNITURE' - SANALMAYDIGAN:

  'a furniture' yoki 'furnitures' - XATO.
  ⚠ Sanash uchun: 'a piece of furniture'.


⚠ 'TO SELL' va 'TO BUY' - AKSLAR:

  sell - sold - sold (noto'g'ri fe'l)
  buy - bought - bought (noto'g'ri fe'l)


⚠ 'TO SUIT' - ESLATMA:

  19-betdagi 9-mashqda: 'something to
  SUIT everyone's taste and pocket'.

modelSentences.sentence: Paris is a shopper's paradise.
modelSentences.uz: Parij - xaridorning jannati.

modelSentences.sentence: There are plenty of small shops in the city centre.
modelSentences.uz: Shahar markazida ko'plab kichik do'konlar bor.

modelSentences.uz: Antikvariat do'konlaridan ajoyib mebel topish mumkin.

modelSentences.uz: Univermaglar kiyimdan ikragacha hamma narsani sotadi.

modelSentences.uz: Har kimning didiga mos narsa doim topiladi.

modelSentences.sentence: Collectors can find rare books on the bookstalls.
modelSentences.uz: Kolleksionerlar kitob rastalaridan noyob kitoblar topa oladi.

modelSentences.sentence: You can buy cheap clothes during the big sales.
modelSentences.uz: Katta chegirmalar paytida arzon kiyim sotib olish mumkin.

modelSentences.sentence: Collectors often visit antique shops.
modelSentences.uz: Kolleksionerlar ko'pincha antikvariat do'konlariga boradi.

modelSentences.sentence: There are famous fashion houses, such as Chanel and Dior.
modelSentences.uz: Chanel va Dior kabi mashhur moda uylari bor.

modelSentences.sentence: 'All things, for all people, everywhere' is the Harrods motto.
modelSentences.uz: 'Hamma narsa, hamma uchun, hamma joyda' - Harrodsning shiori.

modelSentences.uz: Harrodsning o'z o't o'chirish bo'limi bor.

modelSentences.uz: Harrodsning raisi janob Muhammad Al Fayed.

modelSentences.uz: Dorilarni dorixonadan sotib olish mumkin.

modelSentences.uz: Do'kon qo'riqchilar, shifokorlar va hamshiralarni ishga oladi.

modelSentences.uz: Katta univermaglar mahsulotlarning katta turini taklif etadi.

modelSentences.uz: Harrods yong'in va ikki portlashdan omon qolgan.

modelSentences.uz: Harrods - tashrif buyurishga arziydigan maftunkor joy.

modelSentences.uz: Chegirmaning birinchi kunida 300 000 dan ortiq xaridor do'konga keladi.

modelSentences.uz: Galeri Lafayet yuqori sifatli jun yubkalar taklif etadi.

modelSentences.uz: Katta chegirmalar kuzgi kolleksiyalardan oldin bo'ladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
/h/ TOVUShI.

  ⚠ Bu unitning talaffuz mavzusi -
  3-betdagi mundarijada 'Pronunciation:
  /h/' deb yozilgan edi.


⚠ /h/ QANDAY AYTILADI:

  Og'izdan YENGIL nafas chiqariladi -
  tomoqdan emas.

  ⚠ O'zbek tilidagi 'h' ga o'xshaydi,
  lekin 'x' ga EMAS.
  ⚠ 'hat' - 'xat' EMAS!


⚠ QAChON /h/ O'QILMAYDI:

  1) 'hour', 'honest', 'honour', 'heir'
     so'zlarida (17-betdagi 27-mashq)

  2) 'he', 'him', 'his', 'her', 'have',
     'has', 'had' so'zlari gap
     O'RTASIDA kelganda - tez nutqda
     'h' yo'qoladi:

     'Who hit her?' → /huː ˈhɪt ə/
        (oxirgi 'her' da 'h' yo'q)
     'I haven't heard from Henry.'
        (bu yerda 'h' O'QILADI, chunki
        so'z URG'ULI)

  ⚠ Bu hodisa 'h-dropping' deb ataladi
  va TEZ nutqning tabiiy qismi.


BETDAGI MAShQLAR:

  1) hat - have - hot - hear
     ⚠ To'rt xil unli, bir xil /h/.

  2) 'Who hit her?'
     ⚠ 'who' da 'h' O'QILMAYDI (/huː/),
     'hit' da O'QILADI, 'her' da tez
     nutqda TUShADI.

  3) "I haven't heard from Henry for
     ages."
     ⚠ Uchta /h/ ketma-ket.
     ⚠ 'for ages' = uzoq vaqtdan beri.

  4) 'Harriet has got a hundred hats.'
     ⚠ To'rtta /h/.

  5) "He hasn't had a holiday for years."
     ⚠ To'rtta /h/.

  6) 'Harry hates hot dogs.'
     ⚠ To'rtta /h/.


⚠ 'FOR AGES' va 'FOR YEARS':

  Ikkalasi ham 'uzoq vaqtdan beri'.
  ⚠ PRESENT PERFECT bilan ishlatiladi -
  bu 7-unitning mavzusi.


⚠ 'WHO' - 'W' O'QILMAYDI:

  'who' /huː/ - 'w' jim, 'h' o'qiladi.
  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'whole', 'whose'.
  ⚠ Lekin 'what', 'when', 'where' da
  'h' jim, 'w' o'qiladi!

lines.whyUz:
⚠ To'rt xil unli, bir xil /h/ tovushi.
⚠ 'hat' - 'xat' EMAS! /h/ yengil nafas.

⚠ 'who' /huː/ - 'w' O'QILMAYDI.
⚠ 'hit' da 'h' O'QILADI.
⚠ Tez nutqda 'her' dagi 'h' TUShADI: /ə/.

lines.en: I haven't heard from Henry for ages.
lines.uz: Genridan uzoq vaqtdan beri xabar yo'q.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Uchta /h/ ketma-ket: haven't, heard, Henry.
⚠ 'to hear FROM sb' = kimdandir xabar olmoq.
⚠ 'for ages' = uzoq vaqtdan beri.

lines.en: Harriet has got a hundred hats.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ To'rtta /h/: Harriet, has, hundred, hats.
⚠ 'a hundred' - 'AN hundred' EMAS, chunki 'h'
O'QILADI.

lines.en: He hasn't had a holiday for years.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ To'rtta /h/: He, hasn't, had, holiday.
⚠ PRESENT PERFECT + 'for years'.

⚠ To'rtta /h/: Harry, hates, hot, dogs (dogs da
yo'q - uchta).
⚠ 'to hate' dan keyin -ING yoki OT.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, read out the dialogue.
exercises.explanationUz:
BRYUSSEL - BELGIYa POYTAXTI.

  Dialogda ikki do'st: A (Alice) va
  L (Lisa). Lisa Bryusselni biladi va
  Alice'ga do'konlarni ko'rsatadi.


⚠ BRYUSSEL NIMASI BILAN MAShHUR:

  • ShOKOLAD (Leonidas - mashhur
    shokolad do'koni)
  • TO'R (lace) - qo'lda to'qilgan
    Bryussel to'ri butun dunyoda
    mashhur
  • ANTIKVARIAT (Sablon tumani)

  ⚠ Betdagi oval rasm ham TO'R
  naqshida ishlangan.


DIALOGDAGI JOYLAR:

  the Sablon District - antikvariat
     tumani
  Dewindt on Lebeaustraat - antikvariat
     do'koni
  Inno Brussels on rue Neuve -
     eng mashhur univermag
  Leonidas on Boterstraat - shokolad
     do'koni
  F. Rubbrecht in the Grand-Place -
     to'r do'koni

  ⚠ 'straat' - gollandcha 'ko'cha';
  'rue' - fransuzcha 'ko'cha'.
  Bryusselda IKKI rasmiy til bor -
  shuning uchun ko'cha nomlari ikki
  xil.


⚠ 'SHOP TILL YOU DROP' - UNIT NOMI:

  Lisa dialogda aynan shu iborani
  ishlatadi: 'you can shop till you
  drop, my dear'.

  ⚠ Kitob unit nomini matn ichida
  QAYTA ishlatadi - bu tasodif emas.


⚠ 'WHERE SHALL WE GO FIRST?':

  'shall' - TAKLIF va MASLAHAT so'rash
  uchun (faqat 'I' va 'we' bilan).
  ⚠ 'Shall we go?' = boraylikmi?
  ⚠ 'Where shall we go?' = qayerga
  boraylik?


⚠ 'YOU MUST VISIT ...':

  'must' bu yerda MAJBURIYaT emas,
  KUChLI TAVSIYa: 'albatta boring'.


⚠ QUESTION TAGS:

  'Brussels is famous for chocolate and
   lace, ISN'T IT?'
  'The shops are open from nine to six,
   AREN'T THEY?'

  ⚠ Bu 15-unitning grammatika mavzusi.
  ⚠ Qoida: gap TASDIQ bo'lsa tag INKOR,
  gap INKOR bo'lsa tag TASDIQ.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Mm, that was wonderful coffee. Oh, it's so nice to be here in Brussels with you, Lisa - and I can't wait to go shopping!
lines.uz: Mm, qahva ajoyib edi. Bryusselda sen bilan bo'lish juda yoqimli, Liza - va xaridga borishni sabrsizlik bilan kutyapman!
lines.whyUz:
⚠ "I can't wait to ..." = sabrsizlik bilan
kutmoq (9-betdagi xatda ham bor edi).
⚠ 'coffee' - SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning uchun
artikl yo'q.

lines.speaker: L
lines.en: Ah, you've come to the right place, then! Boutiques, confectioner's, lace shops, antique shops, enormous department stores - you can shop till you drop, my dear.
lines.uz: Unda to'g'ri joyga kelibsan! Butiklar, shirinlik do'konlari, to'r do'konlari, antikvariat do'konlari, ulkan univermaglar - charchaguningcha xarid qilishing mumkin, azizim.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Bu yerda UNIT NOMI ishlatilgan:
'shop till you drop'.
⚠ 'enormous' = ulkan.
⚠ Do'kon nomlari 18-betdagi 1-mashqdan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's great! Where shall we go first?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'shall' - taklif/maslahat so'rash uchun,
faqat 'I' va 'we' bilan.
⚠ 'Where shall we go?' = qayerga boraylik?

lines.speaker: L
lines.en: Well, the Sablon District is full of antique shops. You must visit Dewindt on Lebeaustraat. It's got some lovely antiques.
lines.uz: Sablon tumani antikvariat do'konlariga to'la. Lebeaustraatdagi Dewindtga albatta borishing kerak. U yerda ajoyib antikvariat buyumlar bor.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'full OF' - predlog 'of'.
⚠ 'must' bu yerda KUChLI TAVSIYa,
majburiyat emas.
⚠ 'straat' - gollandcha 'ko'cha'.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh, Lisa! Aren't you coming with me?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ INKOR SO'ROQ - hayrat va umidsizlikni
bildiradi.
⚠ 'coming' - PRESENT CONTINUOUS kelasi zamon
ma'nosida.

lines.speaker: L
lines.en: I can't, I'm afraid, but I'll meet you at three, outside Inno Brussels on rue Neuve. It's Brussels' most famous department store, and you can buy everything from clothes to jewellery there.
lines.uz: Afsuski, borolmayman, lekin soat uchda rue Neuve ko'chasidagi Inno Brussels oldida uchrashamiz. Bu Bryusselning eng mashhur univermagi va u yerdan kiyimdan taqinchoqqacha hamma narsa sotib olish mumkin.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ "I'm afraid" = afsuski (18-betda ham bor edi).
⚠ "Brussels'" - 's' bilan tugagan otga egalik:
faqat APOSTROF.
⚠ 'everything from ... to ...' - 19-betdagi
Parij matnida ham shu qolip bor edi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Ooh, that sounds exciting! And what about souvenirs? Brussels is famous for chocolate and lace, isn't it?
lines.uz: Voy, qiziq ekan! Sovg'alar-chi? Bryussel shokolad va to'ri bilan mashhur, shundaymi?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'That sounds ...' - taassurot bildirish.
⚠ 'famous FOR' - predlog 'for'.
⚠ "isn't it?" - QUESTION TAG (15-unit mavzusi):
gap TASDIQ → tag INKOR.

lines.speaker: L
lines.en: Yes, it is, and Leonidas on Boterstraat has the most delicious pralines in the world. We can also go to F. Rubbrecht in the Grand-Place. We'll find the best lace there.
lines.uz: Ha, va Boterstraatdagi Leonidasda dunyodagi eng mazali praline konfetlari bor. Yana Grand-Place'dagi F. Rubbrechtga borishimiz mumkin. Eng yaxshi to'rni o'sha yerdan topamiz.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'the most delicious' - ENG YUQORI daraja
(uzun sifat).
⚠ 'the best' - QOIDASIZ eng yuqori daraja.
⚠ 'a praline' - 18-betdagi 2-mashqda ham bor edi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Will we have enough time? The shops are open from nine to six, aren't they?
lines.uz: Vaqtimiz yetadimi? Do'konlar to'qqizdan oltigacha ochiq, shundaymi?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'enough' OTDAN OLDIN: 'enough time'.
(Sifatdan KEYIN: 'good enough'.)
⚠ 'from ... to ...' - vaqt oralig'i.
⚠ "aren't they?" - question tag.

lines.speaker: L
lines.en: That's right, but it's Friday today. Shops are open until 8:00 pm on Fridays. And there are sales every January and July, so ...
lines.uz: To'g'ri, lekin bugun juma. Juma kunlari do'konlar kechki 8 gacha ochiq. Va har yanvar va iyulda chegirmalar bo'ladi, shuning uchun ...
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'on FridayS' - KO'PLIK 'har juma' ma'nosini
beradi.
⚠ 'until' = 'till' (19-betdagi matnda 'till'
ishlatilgan edi).
⚠ Chegirma oylari 21-betdagi Harrods matni
bilan BIR XIL: yanvar va iyul.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The sales are on now? That's great! I can find some bargains!
lines.uz: Chegirmalar hozir ketyaptimi? Zo'r! Arzon narsalar topaman!
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'to be on' = davom etmoq, ketmoq.
⚠ 'a bargain' = arzonga tushgan narsa, foydali
xarid. Talaffuzi /ˈbɑːɡɪn/ - oxirgi 'ai' /ɪ/.

lines.speaker: L
lines.en: Of course you can. Didn't I tell you? Brussels really is the best place for shoppers!
lines.uz: Albatta topasan. Aytmaganmidim? Bryussel haqiqatan ham xaridorlar uchun eng yaxshi joy!
lines.whyUz:
⚠ "Didn't I tell you?" - INKOR SO'ROQ:
'men aytmaganmidim?'
⚠ 'really IS' - 'is' ta'kidlangan (kuchaytirish).
⚠ 'the best place FOR' - predlog 'for'.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR 30a DIALOGIDA BOR.

  ⚠ Kassetada shu dialog o'qiladi -
  mashqni AUDIOSIZ ham bajarish mumkin.

  ⚠ Oltita savol - 30b mashqidagi
  maqolaning REJASI ham shu:
     1-2  → 1-xatboshi
     2-3  → 2-xatboshi
     4-5  → 3-xatboshi
     6    → 4-xatboshi


⚠ 'TO TAKE PLACE':

  = bo'lib o'tmoq, sodir bo'lmoq.
  'When do the sales take place?'
  ⚠ 'to happen' bilan bir xil ma'no,
  lekin rejalashtirilgan voqea uchun.


⚠ 'TO RECOMMEND':

  = tavsiya qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'to recommend sth TO sb'.
  ⚠ Imlosi: BITTA 'c', IKKI 'm'.

items.question: Which city are the speakers in?
items.whyUz:
⚠ Dialogning birinchi gapida: 'it's so nice to
be here in BRUSSELS'.
⚠ Bryussel - Belgiya poytaxti.

items.question: What shops can you find there?
items.answer: Boutiques, confectioner's, lace shops, antique shops and enormous department stores.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Lizaning ikkinchi gapida to'liq ro'yxat bor.
⚠ Hamma nom 18-betdagi 1-mashqda o'rganilgan.

items.prompt: Bu do'konlardan nima sotib olish mumkin?
items.question: What can you buy at these shops?
items.answer: Antiques, clothes, jewellery, chocolate, pralines and lace.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'everything from clothes to jewellery',
'the most delicious pralines', 'the best lace'.
⚠ 'jewellery' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot.

items.question: What are the opening hours?
items.answer: The shops are open from nine to six, and until 8:00 pm on Fridays.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'opening hours' - 21-betdagi 18a mashqida ham
shu sarlavha bor edi.
⚠ 'on FridayS' - har juma.

items.question: When do the sales take place?
items.answer: They take place every January and July.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to take place' = bo'lib o'tmoq.
⚠ 21-betdagi Harrods matnida ham chegirma
oylari YaNVAR va IYUL edi.

items.prompt: Liza bu joyni Alisga qanday tavsiya qiladi?
items.question: How does Lisa recommend the place to Alice?
items.answer: She says: 'Brussels really is the best place for shoppers!'
items.whyUz:
⚠ Dialogning OXIRGI gapi - tavsiya.
⚠ Maqolada ham tavsiya OXIRGI xatboshida
bo'ladi.

sections.title: Writing (an article about the shopping facilities in a city)

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an article about the shopping facilities in a big city, we can divide it into four paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Katta shahardagi savdo imkoniyatlari haqida maqola yozganda uni to'rt xatboshiga bo'lish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI - MAQOLA QOIDASI.


TO'RT XATBOShI:

  1-xatboshi:
     ShAHAR NOMI va u yerda qanday
     TURDAGI do'konlar borligi

  2-xatboshi:
     ENG YaXShI do'konlarning NOMLARI,
     ular QAYERDA va u yerdan NIMA
     sotib olish mumkin

  3-xatboshi:
     ISh VAQTI va ChEGIRMA vaqtlari

  4-xatboshi (oxirgi):
     joyni xaridorlarga TAVSIYa qilish


⚠ ZAMON: PRESENT SIMPLE

  Maqola DOIMIY holat haqida -
  do'konlar har doim shu yerda,
  har doim shu vaqtda ochiq.


⚠ SARLAVHA MUHIM:

  'We give the article an interesting
   TITLE to attract the reader's
   attention.'

  ⚠ 19-betdagi maqola sarlavhasi
  'Exotic Shopping in Paris' edi -
  qiziqish uyg'otadi.

  ⚠ 'to attract attention' = e'tiborni
  tortmoq.


⚠ BU TUZILISh 19-BETDAGI MATNDA
AYNAN BOR:

  Parij maqolasining to'rt xatboshisi
  aynan shu rejaga tushadi:
     1 - A Shopper's Paradise
     2 - Places to Go and Things to Buy
     3 - Opening Hours
     4 - Recommendation

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 30b da 'Use the text
  in Ex. 6 as a model' deyilgan.


⚠ 'FACILITIES':

  = imkoniyatlar, qulayliklar.
  ⚠ HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA bu ma'noda.
  ⚠ 'shopping facilities' = savdo
  imkoniyatlari.

points.en: In the first paragraph, we state the name of the city and the types of shops you can find there.
points.uz: Birinchi xatboshida shahar nomini va u yerda qanday turdagi do'konlar borligini yozamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to state' = aytmoq, bayon qilmoq (rasmiy).
⚠ 19-betdagi Parij matnining 1-xatboshisi
aynan shunday.

points.en: In the second paragraph, we state the names of the best shops, where they are and what we can buy there.
points.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida eng yaxshi do'konlarning nomlarini, ular qayerdaligini va u yerdan nima sotib olish mumkinligini yozamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ UCh narsa: NOM + JOY + MAHSULOT.
⚠ Bu - eng UZUN xatboshi.

points.en: In the third paragraph, we state the opening hours and the sales times.
points.uz: Uchinchi xatboshida ish vaqti va chegirma vaqtlarini yozamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'opening hours' = ish vaqti.
⚠ 'sales times' = chegirma vaqtlari.

points.en: In the last paragraph, we recommend the place to shoppers.
points.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida joyni xaridorlarga tavsiya qilamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to recommend sth TO sb'.
⚠ Tavsiya HAR DOIM oxirgi xatboshida -
9, 19, 21-betlarda ham shunday edi.

points.en: We normally use the present simple in such articles. We give the article an interesting title to attract the reader's attention.
points.uz: Bunday maqolalarda odatda present simple ishlatamiz. Maqolaga o'quvchi e'tiborini tortish uchun qiziqarli sarlavha qo'yamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'such articles' = bunday maqolalar.
⚠ 'to attract attention' = e'tiborni tortmoq.
⚠ "the reader's attention" - egalik apostrofi.

exercises.instructionEn: You have been asked to write an article for a travel magazine about the shopping facilities in Brussels. Use the text in Ex. 6 as a model and the dialogue in Ex. 30a to write your article. (100 - 150 words)
exercises.instructionUz: Sizdan sayohat jurnali uchun Bryusseldagi savdo imkoniyatlari haqida maqola yozish so'ralgan. 19-betdagi matnni namuna, 30a dialogini esa ma'lumot manbai qiling. (100 - 150 so'z)
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  INTRODUCTION
     Para 1: name of city, types of
             shops in general

  MAIN BODY
     Para 2: names of best shops, where
             they are, what you can buy
             there
     Para 3: opening hours & sales time(s)

  CONCLUSION
     Para 4: recommendation


DIALOGDAN OLINADIGAN MA'LUMOT:

  Shahar: Brussels
  Do'kon turlari: boutiques,
     confectioner's, lace shops,
     antique shops, enormous department
     stores
  Eng yaxshi do'konlar:
     Dewindt (Lebeaustraat) - antiques
     Inno Brussels (rue Neuve) -
        clothes, jewellery
     Leonidas (Boterstraat) - pralines
     F. Rubbrecht (Grand-Place) - lace
  Ish vaqti: 9:00 - 18:00;
     jumada 20:00 gacha
  Chegirmalar: yanvar va iyul
  Tavsiya: 'the best place for shoppers'


⚠ SARLAVHA O'YLAB TOPING:

  'Shopping in Brussels'
  'Brussels: A Shopper's Dream'
  'Chocolate, Lace and Bargains'

  ⚠ Qoida: sarlavha QIZIQARLI bo'lishi
  va e'tiborni tortishi kerak.


⚠ HAJM: 100-150 SO'Z

  To'rt xatboshi - har biri 2-4 gap.

structure.modelEn: Shopping in Brussels: A Shopper's Dream
structure.noteUz:
⚠ Sarlavha QIZIQARLI bo'lishi kerak.
⚠ 19-betdagi 'Exotic Shopping in Paris' bilan
bir xil uslub.

structure.modelEn: Brussels, the capital of Belgium, is a shopper's paradise. There are boutiques, confectioner's, lace shops, antique shops and enormous department stores.
structure.modelUz: Belgiya poytaxti Bryussel - xaridorning jannati. Bu yerda butiklar, shirinlik do'konlari, to'r do'konlari, antikvariat do'konlari va ulkan univermaglar bor.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 19-betdagi Parij matnining birinchi gapi
bilan BIR XIL qolip.
⚠ IZOh verguller bilan ajratiladi.

structure.headingUz: 2-xatboshi: eng yaxshi do'konlar, qayerda, nima sotiladi
structure.modelEn: Antique lovers must visit Dewindt on Lebeaustraat, which has some lovely antiques. Inno Brussels on rue Neuve is the city's most famous department store, where you can buy everything from clothes to jewellery. For souvenirs, go to Leonidas on Boterstraat for the most delicious pralines in the world, and to F. Rubbrecht in the Grand-Place for the best lace.
structure.modelUz: Antikvariat ixlosmandlari Lebeaustraatdagi Dewindtga borishi kerak - u yerda ajoyib antikvariat buyumlar bor. Rue Neuve'dagi Inno Brussels shaharning eng mashhur univermagi, u yerdan kiyimdan taqinchoqqacha hamma narsa sotib olish mumkin. Sovg'alar uchun Boterstraatdagi Leonidasga - dunyodagi eng mazali praline konfetlari uchun, va Grand-Place'dagi F. Rubbrechtga - eng yaxshi to'r uchun boring.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ Eng UZUN xatboshi.
⚠ Har do'kon uchun: NOM + JOY + MAHSULOT.
⚠ 'which' va 'where' - nisbiy olmoshlar
(12-unit mavzusi).

structure.modelEn: The shops are usually open from nine in the morning till six in the evening, and until eight o'clock on Fridays. The big sales take place every January and July.
structure.modelUz: Do'konlar odatda ertalab to'qqizdan kechqurun oltigacha, juma kunlari esa soat sakkizgacha ochiq. Katta chegirmalar har yanvar va iyulda bo'ladi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'from ... till ...' - vaqt oralig'i.
⚠ 'on FridayS' - har juma.
⚠ 'to take place' = bo'lib o'tmoq.

structure.modelEn: Don't miss the chance to go shopping in Brussels. It really is the best place for shoppers!
structure.modelUz: Bryusselda xaridga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang. U haqiqatan ham xaridorlar uchun eng yaxshi joy!
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 19-betdagi Parij matnining oxirgi xatboshisi
bilan BIR XIL qolip.
⚠ 'really IS' - ta'kid (dialogdan olingan).

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean? - In good times people want to advertise, in bad times they have to. Money makes the world go round.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi? - Yaxshi kunlarda odamlar reklama qilishni xohlaydi, yomon kunlarda esa majbur bo'ladi. Pul dunyoni aylantiradi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI HIKMATLI SO'Z.


1) 'IN GOOD TIMES PEOPLE WANT TO
   ADVERTISE, IN BAD TIMES THEY
   HAVE TO.'

  MA'NOSI: Ishlar yaxshi ketayotganda
  reklama - TANLOV; ishlar yomon
  ketayotganda esa reklama - ZARURAT,
  chunki savdoni tiklash kerak.

  ⚠ GRAMMATIK JIHATDAN JUDA MUHIM GAP:

     'want TO' - XOHLASh (tanlov)
     'have TO' - MAJBURIYaT (zarurat)

  ⚠ Gap oxirida 'advertise' fe'li
  TAKRORLANMAYDI - faqat 'to' qoladi.
  Bu 'to-infinitive ellipsis' deb
  ataladi:
     'I don't want to go, but I have to.'

  ⚠ 'have to' - 10-unitning grammatika
  mavzusi.

  ⚠ 'to advertise' = reklama qilmoq
     → 'an advertisement' = reklama
     (qisqasi: 'an advert' yoki 'an ad')


2) 'MONEY MAKES THE WORLD GO ROUND.'

  So'zma-so'z: 'Pul dunyoni
  aylantiradi.'

  MA'NOSI: Dunyodagi ko'p narsa pul
  tufayli harakatga keladi - savdo,
  ish, taraqqiyot.

  ⚠ 'to make sb/sth DO sth' -
  MAJBURLASh qolipi: 'to' YO'Q!
     'make the world GO' ('to go' EMAS)
     'It makes me laugh.'
     'She made him wait.'

  ⚠ Bu - eng ko'p xato qilinadigan
  qoliplardan biri.

  ⚠ 'money' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot,
  shuning uchun fe'l BIRLIKDA:
  'Money MAKES' ('money make' XATO).

  ⚠ O'zbekchada: 'Pul - dunyoning
  ustuni.'


⚠ NIMA UChUN BU MAQOLLAR ShU YERDA:

  Unit XARID va SAVDO haqida.
  Ikkala maqol ham pul va savdoning
  hayotdagi o'rni haqida - unit
  mavzusiga to'g'ri keladi.

items.en: In good times people want to advertise, in bad times they have to.
items.uz: Yaxshi kunlarda odamlar reklama qilishni xohlaydi, yomon kunlarda esa majbur bo'ladi.
items.answerEn: It means that when business is good, advertising is a choice, but when business is bad, it is necessary.
items.answerUz: Bu shuni anglatadiki, savdo yaxshi ketayotganda reklama - tanlov, yomon ketayotganda esa zarurat.

items.en: What is the difference between 'want to' and 'have to'?
items.uz: 'want to' va 'have to' orasidagi farq nima?
items.answerEn: 'Want to' means you choose to do it; 'have to' means you must do it.

items.en: Money makes the world go round.
items.answerEn: It means that money is what makes business, work and progress happen.
items.answerUz: Bu shuni anglatadiki, savdo, ish va taraqqiyot pul tufayli harakatga keladi.

items.en: Is there a similar saying in your language?
items.uz: Sizning tilingizda shunga o'xshash maqol bormi?
items.answerEn: Yes. In Uzbek we say: 'Money is the pillar of the world.'

sentencePatterns.introUz: Shahar va savdo haqida maqola qoliplari.

patterns.exampleEn: That's great! Where shall we go first?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'shall' - taklif va maslahat so'rash uchun,
faqat 'I' va 'we' bilan.
⚠ 'Shall we go?' = boraylikmi?

patterns.exampleEn: You must visit Dewindt on Lebeaustraat. It's got some lovely antiques.
patterns.exampleUz: Lebeaustraatdagi Dewindtga albatta boring. U yerda ajoyib antikvariat buyumlar bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'must' bu yerda KUChLI TAVSIYa, majburiyat
emas.
⚠ Maqolada tavsiya berish uchun juda qulay.

patterns.exampleEn: Brussels is famous for chocolate and lace, isn't it?
patterns.exampleUz: Bryussel shokolad va to'ri bilan mashhur, shundaymi?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'famous FOR' - predlog 'for'.
⚠ "isn't it?" - QUESTION TAG: gap TASDIQ →
tag INKOR (15-unit mavzusi).

patterns.formula: The shops are open from [vaqt] to [vaqt], and until [vaqt] on [kun]s.
patterns.exampleEn: The shops are open from nine to six, and until eight on Fridays.
patterns.exampleUz: Do'konlar to'qqizdan oltigacha, juma kunlari esa sakkizgacha ochiq.

patterns.formula: The sales take place every [oy] and [oy].
patterns.exampleEn: The big sales take place every January and July.
patterns.exampleUz: Katta chegirmalar har yanvar va iyulda bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to take place' = bo'lib o'tmoq.
⚠ Oy nomlari KATTA harf bilan.

'Money makes the world GO round' - 'to' YO'Q! Bu majburlash qolipi.
